name: vartestn
expr: [pB, sB] = vartestn(xg, g, 'Display', 'off'); [pLA, sLA] = vartestn(xg, g, 'Display', 'off', 'TestType', 'LeveneAbsolute'); [pLQ, sLQ] = vartestn(xg, g, 'Display', 'off', 'TestType', 'LeveneQuadratic'); [pBF, sBF] = vartestn(xg, g, 'Display', 'off', 'TestType', 'BrownForsythe'); [pOB, sOB] = vartestn(xg, g, 'Display', 'off', 'TestType', 'OBrien'); [pM, sM] = vartestn(M, 'Display', 'off');
comment: Sig: [p, stats] = vartestn(x[, group][, 'Display', 'off'][, 'TestType', name]). Five test variants: Bartlett (default, χ² stat), LeveneQuadratic / LeveneAbsolute / BrownForsythe / OBrien (all F-based). When no group: matrix input where each column is treated as a separate group. Bartlett returns {chisqstat, df}; F-based tests return {fstat, df=[k-1, N-k]}.
